records.translation: डिज़ाइन नियम:

records.context: **Collectors do not throw.** Every collector executes through :func:`_collect`, which turns a failure into a manifest entry naming what could not be gathered and why. Catching ``Exception`` is acceptable here because the failure is recorded in the output: the manifest is part of the bundle, so a missing section is visible to the report recipient instead of silently absent.
records.label: spacr.crashreport#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Collectors do not raise.** Every collector runs through :func:`_collect`, which turns a failure into a manifest entry naming what could not be gathered and why. Catching ``Exception`` is acceptable here because the failure is recorded in the output: the manifest is part of the bundle, so a missing section is visible to the report recipient instead of silently absent.
records.translation: **संग्राहक अपवाद नहीं फेंकते।** हर संग्राहक :func:`_collect` से होकर चलता है, जो विफलता को एक सूची-पत्र प्रविष्टि में बदलता है जो बताती है कि क्या एकत्र नहीं हो सका और क्यों। यहाँ ``Exception`` पकड़ना स्वीकार्य है क्योंकि विफलता आउटपुट में दर्ज होती है: सूची-पत्र बंडल का भाग है, इसलिए अनुपस्थित खंड रिपोर्ट प्राप्तकर्ता को चुपचाप गायब होने के बजाय दिखाई देता है।

records.context: **Bounded size.** ``spacr.log`` rotates but a single run can still write hundreds of megabytes. The bundle takes the *tail* of it, capped by :data:`MAX_LOG_BYTES`, and the manifest records how much was dropped.
records.label: spacr.crashreport#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Bounded size.** ``spacr.log`` rotates but a single run can still write hundreds of megabytes. The bundle takes the *tail* of it, capped by :data:`MAX_LOG_BYTES`, and the manifest records how much was dropped.
records.translation: **सीमित आकार।** ``spacr.log`` घूर्णित होता है पर एक निष्पादन फिर भी सैकड़ों मेगाबाइट लिख सकता है। बंडल इसका *अंतिम भाग* लेता है, :data:`MAX_LOG_BYTES` तक सीमित, और सूची-पत्र दर्ज करता है कि कितना छोड़ा गया।

records.context: **Nothing secret.** Environment variables are included because ``SPACR_*``, ``CUDA_*`` and ``PATH`` explain a large fraction of "works here, not there" — but a value whose *name* looks like a credential is replaced with ``"<redacted>"`` and listed by name in the manifest, so you can see what was withheld and the report recipient can see that something was. Absolute paths are kept: they name the checkout, the plate and the database, and a report with them stripped cannot be acted on.

records.context: A join answers "give me every pathogen with its cell's area". A tree answers "what is inside this cell", which is a different question and the one a person looking at an extracted image region actually has. The difference shows up in the failures: a join silently drops a cell with no pathogens and silently drops a pathogen whose ``cell_id`` names a cell that is not there. Both of those are findings — the first is the negative control working, the second is a segmentation bug — so :func:`build_forest` keeps childless parents and :func:`orphans` returns the unattached children rather than discarding them.
records.label: spacr.lineage#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A join answers "give me every pathogen with its cell's area". A tree answers "what is inside this cell", which is a different question and the one a person looking at a crop actually has. The difference shows up in the failures: a join silently drops a cell with no pathogens and silently drops a pathogen whose ``cell_id`` names a cell that is not there. Both of those are findings — the first is the negative control working, the second is a segmentation bug — so :func:`build_forest` keeps childless parents and :func:`orphans` returns the unattached children rather than discarding them.

records.source: A. A fit with the same output -- joins `regression_type`. B. A diagnostic laid over the data -- belongs on a plot, never decides hits. C. An agreement check -- reports a comparison against the linear ranking, and names the guides the two disagree about.
records.translation: A. समान आउटपुट वाला फ़िट -- `regression_type` में जुड़ता है। B. डेटा पर रखा गया निदान -- प्लॉट पर रहता है, कभी हिट तय नहीं करता। C. सहमति जाँच -- रैखिक श्रेणीकरण से तुलना बताता है, और उन गाइडों का नाम देता है जिन पर दोनों असहमत हैं।

records.context: What each method fits is not always the guide design. spaCR's fit is guide -> phenotype at microplate sample position level with one column per guide: high dimensional, sparse and categorical, which is the worst case for most of these. Against a continuous covariate -- guide abundance in the microplate sample position, cell count, laboratory microplate position -- they are microplate sample position suited, and the smoothers are used there: showing whether the phenotype moves smoothly with a nuisance variable the linear model is assuming away.
records.label: spacr.nonparametric_fits#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: What each method fits is not always the guide design. spaCR's fit is guide -> phenotype at well level with one column per guide: high dimensional, sparse and categorical, which is the worst case for most of these. Against a continuous covariate -- guide abundance in the well, cell count, plate position -- they are well suited, and the smoothers are used there: showing whether the phenotype moves smoothly with a nuisance variable the linear model is assuming away.
records.translation: प्रत्येक विधि जो फ़िट करती है वह हमेशा गाइड डिज़ाइन नहीं होता। spaCR का फ़िट वेल स्तर पर गाइड -> लक्षणप्ररूप है, प्रति गाइड एक स्तंभ के साथ: उच्च आयामी, विरल और श्रेणीगत, जो इनमें से अधिकांश के लिए सबसे खराब स्थिति है। सतत सहचर के विरुद्ध -- वेल में गाइड प्रचुरता, कोशिका गिनती, प्लेट स्थिति -- वे अच्छी तरह उपयुक्त हैं, और स्मूदर वहीं उपयोग होते हैं: यह दिखाते हुए कि क्या लक्षणप्ररूप किसी ऐसे बाधक चर के साथ सहज रूप से बदलता है जिसे रैखिक मॉडल मान्यता से हटा रहा है।

records.context: This measures an ENCODING fault rather than a drawing one. Saving a GIF with ``disposal=2`` tells a decoder to clear each frame to the background colour before drawing the next; when the encoder then optimises a frame down to the sub-rectangle that actually changed, everything outside that rectangle is left showing the background. records.source: This measures an ENCODING fault rather than a drawing one. Saving a GIF with ``disposal=2`` tells a decoder to clear each frame to the background colour before drawing the next; when the encoder then optimises a frame down to the sub-rectangle that actually changed, everything outside that rectangle is left showing the background. The animation plays with a bright ring flashing around it once per loop, and Qt's ``QMovie`` renders it exactly as described -- this was measured through the GUI path, not inferred from the file.
records.translation: यह चित्रण दोष के बजाय एन्कोडिंग (ENCODING) दोष मापता है। ``disposal=2`` के साथ GIF सहेजना डिकोडर को बताता है कि अगला फ़्रेम खींचने से पहले हर फ़्रेम को पृष्ठभूमि रंग से साफ़ करे; जब एन्कोडर फिर किसी फ़्रेम को वास्तव में बदले उप-आयत तक अनुकूलित करता है, तो उस आयत के बाहर सब कुछ पृष्ठभूमि दिखाता रह जाता है। एनिमेशन हर चक्र में एक बार अपने चारों ओर चमकती उज्ज्वल वलय के साथ चलता है, और Qt का ``QMovie`` उसे ठीक वैसा ही रेंडर करता है जैसा वर्णित है -- यह GUI मार्ग से मापा गया, फ़ाइल से अनुमानित नहीं।
